messages:
Maya PR: Quick sync — embargo goes live Thu 2026-05-15 16:00 UTC. Need final quote approvals by Wed 2026-05-13 11:00 PT. Who's owning quote sign-off?
Liam Marketing: @Maya PR I can chase legal for the quote language. Which execs need to sign?
Maya PR: Nora (CEO) and Evan (Head of Product). Draft quote below — please react :eyes: if we should send this to legal as-is:
> "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference at scale, enabling engineering teams to ship features faster."
Sofia Comms: That reads well but legal historically prefers 'cost-aware' over 'cost-efficient'. Evan — ok to swap? Also we should call out Dedicated for enterprise customers in one line.
Evan PM: Agree on 'cost-aware'. Fine to add one line about Dedicated. Suggest demo callouts for throughput + isolation.
Maya PR: Updated draft to send to legal:
> "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, cost-aware LLM inference at scale, letting engineering teams ship features faster. Our Dedicated offering provides predictable throughput and isolation for regulated workloads."
Liam Marketing: Booking windows for analyst briefings across time zones — flag conflicts. Proposed slots (UTC):
- APAC: 2026-05-15 01:00–03:00 UTC (covers APAC morning local)
- EMEA: 2026-05-15 08:00–11:00 UTC
- NA:   2026-05-15 16:00–19:00 UTC
Sofia Comms: Heads-up — Nora can't do APAC after 02:00 UTC. Can we route APAC to Evan + product demo? That would avoid late-night for execs.
Maya PR: Yes — Evan will front APAC briefings. Nora will take EMEA and a limited NA interviewer list.
PressBot: Automated note — embargo metadata added: embargo_release=2026-05-15T16:00:00Z; embargoed_assets=[press-release.pdf, benchmark-methodology.xlsx]; owner=@Maya PR
Liam Marketing: Fact-check process: legal requests 48h turnaround. We'll send the fact-check form with deadline 2026-05-13 20:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.docs/factcheck/seq123 
Evan PM: For the demo, I'll need confirmed model config + token budget. Plan to run 512-token demo for latency numbers and a 128-token interactive flow. Please attach perf baseline.
Sofia Comms: Also need the embargoed benchmark readout and short narrative (2–3 bullets) for analysts. @Liam Marketing can you confirm who owns the benchmark copy for fact-check?
Liam Marketing: I'll own the bench narrative. Will drop the narrative + raw stats into the Google doc and tag reviewers by EOD today.
Maya PR: Action items recap: @Maya PR collect exec signoffs; @Evan PM finalize demo env + perf snippets; @Liam Marketing send fact-check links + bench narrative; @Sofia Comms assemble briefing packs & one-pager.
Evan PM: Noted — I'll also prepare a short troubleshooting FAQ for analysts (latency variance, quantization tradeoffs).
Maya PR: Thanks all — once Nora signs I'll send calendar invites and the embargo checklist. Please use reactions to confirm you saw your action. :thumbsup:
